rules.description: Application verification is performed concurrently with the application submission.
rules.outcome: Verification activities are carried out at the same time as the application is submitted.
rules.evidence_quote: The Verification of applications will be undertaken concurrently along-with the application process.

rules.description: The verification process commences on 1st June 2017.
rules.condition: At the start of the verification schedule.
rules.evidence_quote: The verification process will therefore, start from 1st June, 2017.

rules.description: The final deadline for completing verification for pre‑matric, Post Matric and Merit cum Means based schemes is 30th September 2017.
rules.condition: For verification of the mentioned schemes.
rules.outcome: All verification must be finished by 30 September 2017.
rules.evidence_quote: The last date for verification for the pre-matric, Post Matric and Merit cum Means based schemes will be 30th September, 2017 (wherein the last date for the first level of verification will be 15th September, 2017)

rules.description: The first level of verification must be completed by 15th September 2017.
rules.condition: For the first level of verification of the pre‑matric, Post Matric and Merit cum Means based schemes.
rules.outcome: First‑level verification must be finished by 15 September 2017.
rules.evidence_quote: wherein the last date for the first level of verification will be 15th September, 2017
